messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High tail latency detected for /v1/generate (p99 4.8s, p95 1.6s) — possible KV cache pressure. Paging oncall: @alice_oncall :rotating_light:
alice_oncall: saw the page, jumping in. any customer-facing impact yet?
ben_sre: seeing p95/p99 spike across several shards, streaming stalls mid-response. tail latency correlates with high KV eviction_rate on shards 12-15.
carla_runtime: logs show a prefill vs decode imbalance — prefill queue is saturated, decode threads drained. stack traces attached in runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/kv-prefill
david_support: one customer reported incomplete streams and timeouts ~2m ago (tickets #4521, #4523). they're seeing repeated retries.
erin_prod: ok please triage severity. If more than 1% requests hitting >3s p99 we need an incident page.
alice_oncall: severity: situational but rising. marking P1 if we can't stabilize within 15m. Flo, Ben — any quick mitigations?
flo_sre: quick telemetry snippet: `kv_cache_utilization: 96%`, `eviction_ops/s: 820`, `prefill_ops/s: 60`, `decode_ops/s: 950` — huge decode:prefill skew. suggests prefill not keeping up with decode which results in decode walking far into disk/paging.
ben_sre: attaching sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z shard=13 evict_rate=845 prefill_queue=987 decode_queue=12 tail_latency_ms=4800
2026-03-15T14:02:14Z shard=14 evict_rate=910 prefill_queue=1203 decode_queue=9 tail_latency_ms=5220
```
carla_runtime: that aligns. Prefill backpressure causing frequent slab compaction -> fragmentation -> paging.
david_support: customers impacted: 3 high-volume customers on dedicated clusters, a handful on hosted API with long-context streaming. Notifying account teams.
alice_oncall: mitigation plan — immediate and midterm: 1) throttle long-context streaming requests by applying rate-limit on streams > 2048 tokens; 2) bump prefill worker threads on affected shard set; 3) add temporary eviction grace for conversation cache to reduce thrash; 4) if still unstable, route traffic to compatible variant with reduced context length. I'll coordinate.
erin_prod: please prioritize account notifications for the dedicated clusters.
flo_sre: implementing throttle rule now: `route-match: request.context_tokens > 2048 -> rate-limit 50rps` pushed to edge.
carla_runtime: I'm increasing prefill workers from 8 -> 14 for shards [12,13,14,15]. running patch: `kubectl set env deploy/prefill --replicas=14 -n inference-shard-12`
ben_sre: also flipping eviction policy to soft-evict for convo keys: `kv.eviction.mode=soft` on those shards. applying now.
incident-bot: deploybot: rollout started for prefill scaling on inference-shard-12..15 (deploy/prefill) — 4 pods updating.
david_support: posting to affected customer threads: "We've detected intermittent streaming timeouts; immediate mitigation in progress, expect improvements in ~10-15 minutes."
~8m later~
flo_sre: telemetry update: `p95 0.72s` (was 1.6s), `p99 1.8s` (was 4.8s), `kv_cache_utilization: 88%`, `eviction_ops/s: 210`, `prefill_ops/s: 430`. improvements but still some tail spikes on shard 14.
carla_runtime: shards warmed after prefill scale up. decode:prefill ratio now ~2.2x not ~16x, good. Streaming stalls decreased.
alice_oncall: good progress. any residual customer errors?
david_support: two follow-ups opened but no new timeouts reported. marking impacted tickets as 'monitoring'.
erin_prod: recommend holding off on route fallback for now — telemetry trending positive.
ben_sre: need durable fix: fragmentation -> slab shrink thresholds too aggressive under high eviction. propose adjust slab_shrink_threshold from 0.2 -> 0.05 and add a soft-prefill-reserve to keep conversation prefixes pinned.
flo_sre: agree. also propose background compaction off-peak and a prefill admission cap per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbors causing prefill starvation.
alice_oncall: immediate actions recorded. I'm handing off to Ben/Flo for follow-up and RCA. I'll close the oncall page when postmortem ops card is created.
ben_sre: taking ownership of post-incident RCA and long-term mitigations. timeline: will produce draft in 48h. assigning to `eng-runtime` and `eng-sre` for kernel/allocator changes.
carla_runtime: docs: added quick mitigation steps to runbook and a small automation to detect decode:prefill skew > 5x and auto-scale prefill.
david_support: sending customer close update: "Mitigations deployed, observing improved latencies. We'll follow up with RCA within 48 hours."
incident-bot: NOTE: Escalation log: pages sent to @alice_oncall, then @ben_sre, @flo_sre.
alice_oncall: closing the active page. follow-ups: 1) postmortem (48h), 2) telemetry alert tuning (raise early warning on decode:prefill skew), 3) tenant prefill admission caps, 4) slab shrink threshold tuning and compaction schedule.
erin_prod: thanks team. great triage. :tada:
ben_sre: quick reminder — file includes key artifacts: heap profiles, kv-slab metrics, per-tenant prefill traces in the incident folder: `s3://redwood-incidents/3187654321/`
flo_sre: leaving a small TODO: simulate noisy tenant to validate prefill cap.
alice_oncall: thread closed for now. reopen if p99 > 3s or errors reappear. :+1:
